summary.text: Golden-Red Armor is Mo Li's killer move and his greatest achievement after seizing a Thieving Heaven true inheritance. Pieces assemble into full-body armor that resists Gu Master attacks at high cost.

claims.text: Facing a group of Gu Masters, Mo Li covers himself in clear electric threads like clothing, then activates the killer move. About a hundred armor pieces float out, follow the electric circuit, and assemble into one suit that sheds golden and red metallic light. Gu Master attacks leave only soot and no real damage; armored Mo Li kills many by collision, then fires electric arrows from circular markings on both palms to finish the rest.

After tens of breaths the armor separates and vanishes with the electricity clothing. Mo Li is emptied of primeval essence, stamina, mental energy, and thoughts; without Peng Da’s full support he would have lasted only half as long. Peng Da’s soul proposes refining electric brain Gu with wisdom bead grass so consumption falls by more than half and duration at least doubles. He built the move after killing Peng Da and taking Peng Da’s Thieving Heaven true inheritance, and with it his battle strength briefly surpasses rank five Gu Masters. He later judges that even armored he cannot endure the collateral damage of a Gu Immortal fight.
